summary: First-party English and Amharic discovery confirmed Jimma's official municipal site and Ethiopia's national urban land/cadastre responsibilities, but no public Jimma parcel geometry, stable native identity, schema, CRS, or anonymous parcel API was verified. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Amharic discovery queries are recorded in city-3132-jimma.json. They found official Jimma municipality, national ministry land/cadastre, legal-context, and Addis e-Land routes; none exposed a usable Jimma parcel layer.
requestOutcomes: Official municipal, ministry, and e-Land routes were inspected anonymously with TLS verification enabled through web discovery. A local curl retry failed at DNS resolution before HTTP. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, formal request submission, or unsafe property lookup was used.
scopeLimits: The Jimma municipal site confirms city administration but does not itself evidence a local cadastral registry or public parcel service.
The national ministry page is general institutional prose and is not proof of Jimma coverage.
The e-Land route found is Addis-focused in the available first-party description; no Jimma route or response was verified.
The DNS failure and lack of a text-exposed viewer response are request/UI limitations, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
The WUP point [7.67102741639804, 36.8415364191598] was preserved exactly and was not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel geometry and identity response was obtained.
This packet is research evidence only and must not be treated as source integration or adapter admission.
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; do not synthesize one from municipal rows, search results, response order, or internal records.
crs: unverified; no parcel geometry response obtained
geometryQuality: not evaluated; no parcel geometry retained
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: A restricted, formal-request, unpublished, or non-indexed Jimma/Oromia cadastral service may exist. Public availability, coverage, parcel schema, CRS, native identity, and safe anonymous runtime access remain unresolved.
